title: Hearing on senior and disability rent and tax exemption programs
summary: The Council's Aging, Disabilities and Finance committees held a joint oversight hearing on the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE) and Disability Rent Increase Exemption (DRIE) programs, which freeze rent for low-income older and disabled tenants. The hearing also examined related bills, including proposals to create a universal SCRIE/DRIE application system, raise income limits for these programs and for the Senior Citizen and Disabled Homeowners' Exemptions, and expand tenant protections and notice requirements, plus resolutions urging state action on rent freeze and property tax relief. Witnesses invited included the Department for the Aging, Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, Department of Finance and Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
